MJ-REQ-015.title: Domain Model — Core Concepts
MJ-REQ-015.interpretation: Original criterion requires nineteen distinguished concepts, not nineteen new tables. Sixteen separate relational entities and three separately validated durable concepts satisfy the architecture distinction. No definition was changed.

criteria.implementation: separately owned search_profiles criteria and source selection
job_sources approved collector policy and capabilities
job_postings raw source identity and provenance
AnswerInput plus independently reviewed reusable answers in immutable profile_versions.answers
application-isolated browser directory and pinned bounded selection manifest
immutable SavedSearchRule shared by settings admission, transfer and scheduler execution
Production Store._profile_on executes mapped CareerProfileRecord/ProfileVersionRecord/CareerFactRecord over existing migration-owned Tables.
ORM predicates and existing Core DML bind all user/job values; injection-shaped profile IDs and text round-trip only as data.
Dedicated runtime login, effective ACL rejection, restricted DML and migration-bookkeeping protections; container entrypoint fails closed on unsafe credential sources.

criteria.criterion: Never concatenate raw job content into SQL
criteria.implementation: Reviewed collector/persistence paths bind raw payload/description/identity as values. Dynamic statements use metadata identifiers or validated integer controls, not job content.

explicit_non_acceptance.MJ-REQ-004: PARTIAL: bounded control-query/request-clock progress does not prove all acquisition, network, recovery and finalization bounds.
explicit_non_acceptance.MJ-REQ-018: PARTIAL: approved strategy/admission and corroborated feed fallback do not prove universal ladder preference or all desired sources.
explicit_non_acceptance.MJ-REQ-264: Acceptance correction: historical PASS was overstated. The original enqueue criterion does not contain the earlier note's extra eligible-origin qualification. A high-match job with no direct employer source, no verified origin and no narrow corroborated native link still creates NEEDS_ORIGIN_REVIEW with zero queued discovery operations. Retain original evidence and downgrade to PARTIAL. This publication also fixes in-place NORMAL-to-HIGH promotion and stale Redis-delivery claim ordering, preserving authorization, identity, queue age, retry/backoff and cancellation state; both PostgreSQL race orders pass. It does not complete automatic origin discovery or preempt running work.

sql_dynamic_statements: workers/operations.py restores an integer SQLite PRAGMA from a driver-reported integer.
packages/persistence/store.py locks declared metadata table identifiers for backup; no raw job content is interpolated.
source_review.raw_job_paths: Raw source identity, description, payload and job attributes remain SQLAlchemy bound values. Exact-source injection-shaped persistence regressions passed.
